p.title: News: a server backstop item from an older cycle is not restored as current
p.symptom: Codex review: a 43.2-hour-old article became current=true through the server fallback (its AI use stayed excluded).
p.root_cause: _aioNormalizeNewsItem trusted any _serverBackstop item's own newsCycleStart/End and capped its age at the window, without checking that the cycle was still the latest one.
p.fix: js/aio-data.js: serverCycleTrusted also requires the item cycle to have ended within one news window (24h) of now.
p.prevention: ci-architecture-browser-check P1403 (30h-old cycle + 43.2h item -> untrusted and stale; latest cycle -> trusted).
p.verification: Browser probe through the page function.
